content: uPlot official benchmark: v1.6.24 is 47.9KB vs Chart.js v4.2.1 254KB (~5x smaller); render 34ms/21MB peak heap vs Chart.js 38ms/29MB peak heap; uPlot scales to millions of points at 60fps. D3 core ~85KB gzip, full bundle ~320KB gzip, tree-shakeable. D3 is a lower-level toolkit not a turnkey chart lib.
